title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenAI DevDay: Dots persistent agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, Agents API with computer use, MCP Events
bullets.summary: OpenAI launched always-on 'Dots' agents, GPT-6.1 Sol (GPT-6 Astra-level on many benchmarks at ~1/5 the price), an Agents API with computer use, multi-agent, tool search and context compression, plus an MCP Events spec for event-driven plugins.
bullets.how: The Construct: MCP Events + persistent-agent patterns map to event-triggered routines instead of pure cron; benchmark Sol for cheap coding/batch jobs. PRAGMA: 'always-on operator' is now a mainstream product category to position against.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.288 (resume/recovery, MCP handling) + $100M Claude Frontier Academy
bullets.summary: Claude Code 2.1.288 ships smarter resume and recovery flows and stronger plugin/MCP handling; Anthropic also announced a $100M academy to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers with Accenture, Deloitte and McKinsey.
bullets.how: The Construct: update Claude Code and re-test long-running scheduled routines against the new resume/recovery flow. PRAGMA: the Academy signals demand for AI-operator talent and a possible partner/credential channel, and competition from big consultancies.

bullets.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon begins rollout; Gemini Skills for cross-app task automation
bullets.summary: Google started rolling out its flagship Gemini 4 Argon, initially to trusted cyber defenders and amid skepticism on coding performance, and launched Gemini Skills to automate repetitive tasks across apps.
bullets.how: The Construct: skills-as-packaged-workflows is converging across vendors; hold model migration until general availability and independent coding benchmarks. PRAGMA: useful comparison point for client model-choice conversations.

bullets.title: Photon raises $4.5M seed for agents delivered over iMessage, WhatsApp, SMS and voice
bullets.summary: Photon, an open-source-first framework for agents that live in messaging channels, raised a $4.5M seed with 40,000+ developer signups and 10x revenue growth in four months.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: messaging-channel agent could handle quote follow-ups and install scheduling with builders/community managers. PRAGMA: a deployable channel layer for client operator agents.

bullets.title: Agent security funding keeps climbing: Armadin $255.5M Series B, Reco $55M
bullets.summary: Armadin raised $255.5M at a $2.5B post-money valuation for AI vulnerability testing, and Reco raised $55M as AI-agent security startups crowd the market; new agent-supervision tools (Classie Supervise, DeepKeep) also launched.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: governance/supervision is now a funded buyer category; include agent audit and control in consulting offers. The Construct: keep per-agent permission scopes and audit trails explicit.

praxis_lesson: Agent vendors are converging on persistent, event-driven agents (OpenAI Dots + MCP Events, Gemini Skills, Claude Code mods) while security and recovery tooling gets funded alongside. Move Construct jobs from clock-driven to event-driven triggers, and make each one resumable and auditable.
